Thanks to rocketman again for the QC.

This book had its high moments, but I think I liked the second book with Saori as its main heroine better overall.

Earlier in the year, Tomohiro Kai put out some concept art on twitter (https://x.com/kai_tomohiro/status/2091161472877637700) of the potential next two characters, as well as a poll asking what people would like to see, with the majority of responders wanting to see new characters rather than developing on ones we've already seen. I don't believe I've seen any posts of them intending to apply for this year's winter comiket, so the continuation of this series is probably still a whiles off. Summer comiket next year, perhaps?
